$comment: Deterministic checkout read smoke cases. Every case must reach the fake core exactly once.

cases.name: payer link view
cases.notes: GET /internal/checkout/pay/:linkKey; response carries a generated UUID, timestamps and a set-like visible_rails array.

cases.name: attempt log timeline
cases.notes: Timeline entries contain timestamps (default drop rule applies).

cases.name: browser return redirect
cases.notes: Edge builds a Location header; the normaliser compares it (allowlist) after placeholder replacement.

cases.name: public certificate verification
cases.notes: Certificate payload has earnedAt/expiresAt timestamps and a request id.
